column2: If you think that, don't come.{wait}{clear}Being fussed over like that wears ME out.
What I like? Let's see... What would it be?{wait}{clear}Reading, or spacing out at the top of the tower, I guess.
You think so...? So much happens every day now that I actually feel more restless.
That's so like you to ask, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}Everything was fun because everyone was there... But that was a long time ago...{wait}{clear}I've forgotten...
Sure, I don't mind. Want to talk some more or something?
You can be pretty strict sometimes, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}I'm a little impressed.
Thanks.{wait}{clear}You're right, being able to relax like this is precious time.{wait}{clear}You get some good rest too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Yeah, I have so much time to think that it's kind of a problem...
I don't go often, but I like markets. All the colorful vegetables and fruit, all that energy...{wait}{clear}It just makes me happy somehow.
Yeah, I'm eating properly.{wait}{clear}You're such a worrier, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. You even worry about that.
Yeah... I know.{n}
Don't say that now that we're here! ＄＄＄＄＄＄, stop making that face and pull yourself together!
It's fine, I know... If I push too hard and get hurt, it's all for nothing.
You're strict, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. But that's only natural.{wait}{clear}Don't worry, I won't let my guard down, no matter the enemy.
There's no point worrying about it now that we're here. All that's left is to size up the enemy during the fight.
Yeah, got it...
Don't say that. I told you I'm fine, so don't worry.
I'm sure you'll be fine, Irene.
Huh? Oh... yeah... Thanks...
If you say it with such a worried face, it feels creepy, right? It's a bad omen, so stop.
I told you I'm fine! Geez, if you're that worried, maybe you shouldn't have come.
No... It's because I wasn't strong enough. Sorry I messed up...
Don't make such a fuss. It'll only hurt more.
I'm glad you care, but if I lose and get hurt, there's nothing to be done...{wait}{clear}If you go on about it, I'll feel even more pathetic, so stop!
It's not your fault, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Don't worry about it so much.
It's okay, I don't need anything.{wait}{clear}Just stay here a little while... It somehow calms me down...
It's not your fault, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. I was just weak...
I don't mind being relied on... So don't worry about it too much.{wait}{clear}Besides, if things always went smoothly, that'd be scary. Things like this are what make me want to try again...
It's my own fault I couldn't size up the enemy...{wait}{clear}I've still got a long way to go. But I won't lose next time.
Putting it like that at a time like this is harsh...{wait}{clear}But maybe you're right, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Maybe I let my guard down a little...
Yeah... Sorry. You're always so kind, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}Thanks.
Owl
Does this owl have a name?
Of course she does! How rude.{wait}{clear}This is Vesta, my dear friend.
Since when?

It's been a long time now. When I went to the forest to gather ingredients for medicine, I found her fallen from her nest.{wait}{clear}She was so weak, I thought she'd die like that, so I took her home with me.{wait}{clear}I'm so glad she's grown up so big and healthy now.{wait}{clear}I'm really glad I met Vesta back then...
She's a good friend to you, Irene.
Yeah, she is. She understands me better than anyone. Right, Vesta?
Tower
Irene, who built the tower you lived in?
Grandpa built that tower. He was a very famous mage...
It's like a treasure trove of knowledge.
I'm kind of happy you think so.{wait}{clear}All of Grandpa's knowledge is packed in there.{wait}{clear}All the magical knowledge he gathered over his whole life...
